{
  "pros": [
    "Extremely easy and intuitive to use for core project management tasks",
    "Streamlined communication and collaboration with built-in tools",
    "Simple and effective to-do list management with quick entry and assignment",
    "Clear overview of project progress and team responsibilities",
    "Focuses on essential features without overwhelming users with complexity",
    "Reliable performance with minimal lag or slowdowns"
  ],
  "cons": [
    "Limited customization options compared to other platforms",
    "Basic reporting features make it hard to track detailed metrics",
    "Can feel restrictive for complex projects or advanced workflows",
    "The free plan is very limited, pushing users to upgrade quickly",
    "Lack of robust integrations with third-party tools",
    "Mobile experience can be less smooth than the desktop version"
  ],
  "overall_rating": 4.0
}
